## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of what the problem or limitation is.
_Example: "I can't inject chaos at the HTTP client level because..."_

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Use-case

Describe the real-world scenario this would help with. This helps us understand whether it fits the project scope.

## Additional context

Any other context, mockups, or references.
